tracks.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
tracks.description: Built backwards from the usual course: the trained skill is recognition — which technique to reach for in the first 45 seconds of reading the constraints.

lessons.title: The Recognition Engine
lessons.desc: The drill that trains the 45 seconds between reading a problem and knowing which technique to reach for — the skill the whole course is built around.

lessons.title: Complexity & the Recognition Reflex
lessons.desc: Reading n backwards to the algorithm; the constraint→complexity table; amortisation; the real cost of Python's operations, measured; the 5-step ritual on every problem.

lessons.title: Hashmap as an Index
lessons.desc: The single highest-yield idea in interview DSA: trade memory for a lookup. Complement trick, seen-index map, frequency map, canonical-key grouping.

lessons.title: Two Pointers
lessons.desc: Opposite-ends vs same-direction vs fast/slow; sortedness as the license; in-place partition; the 'why not just nested loops' derivation.

lessons.title: Sliding Window
lessons.desc: Fixed and variable; the shrink condition as the only hard part; the monotonicity precondition and where it fails; at-most-K minus at-most-(K−1) for exactly-K.

lessons.title: Prefix Sums & Difference Arrays
lessons.desc: Where sliding windows die and prefix+hashmap takes over; 2D prefix; range-update difference array; prefix XOR.

lessons.title: Binary Search & Search on Answer
lessons.desc: One template with one invariant; bisect_left vs bisect_right; rotated arrays; and the senior move: binary searching the answer space on 'minimise the maximum'.

lessons.title: Monotonic Stack & Deque
lessons.desc: 'Next greater', spans, histogram rectangles, sliding-window maximum; the amortised O(n) argument that makes it look like magic.

lessons.title: Heaps & Top-K
lessons.desc: heapq is min-only and what that forces; size-k heap vs full sort vs quickselect; two-heap running median; k-way merge; lazy deletion.

lessons.title: Linked List Surgery
lessons.desc: The dummy head that deletes half your edge cases; in-place reversal; Floyd's cycle detection and phase 2; k-group reversal; LRU as dict+DLL.

lessons.title: Trees & DFS Return-Value Design
lessons.desc: DFS return-value design — the entire skill is choosing what the recursion returns; diameter and max-path-sum; BST invariant; iterative traversal; LCA.

lessons.title: Graphs: BFS, DFS & Modelling
lessons.desc: The real skill is seeing the graph in a problem that never says 'graph'; grid-as-graph; mark visited on enqueue; multi-source BFS; topological sort; 3-colour cycle detection; Dijkstra.

lessons.title: Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union)
lessons.desc: When connectivity is the question and you never need the path; path compression + union by size; the alpha(n) bound; and what it refuses to do.

lessons.title: Backtracking
lessons.desc: Choose/explore/un-choose; subsets vs permutations vs combinations as three configurations of one loop; duplicate pruning with i > start.

lessons.title: Dynamic Programming I: 1D
lessons.desc: Recurrence first, table second; count / optimise / reachability; memo → tabulation → rolling variables; Kadane and LIS via 'ending at i'.

lessons.title: Dynamic Programming II: 2D & Sequences
lessons.desc: State design as the whole game; LCS and edit distance as one table; the knapsack loop direction; combinations vs permutations by loop order; interval DP.

lessons.title: Greedy & Intervals
lessons.desc: The exchange argument as proof obligation; sort-by-end vs sort-by-start; merge/insert/erase; sweep line; and where greedy dies.

lessons.title: Tries & Bit Manipulation
lessons.desc: Prefix structures and why is_word is not optional; trie-pruned grid search; XOR identities; subsets as bitmasks; Python 32-bit trap.

lessons.title: Mock Rounds & 45-Min Protocol
lessons.desc: The 45-minute protocol with live phase clock; the 4-axis rubric and what is actually graded; six recovery scripts; 6 mocks behind reveals.

lessons.title: Advanced Graphs: Shortest Paths, MST & SCC
lessons.desc: Bellman-Ford for negative weights, Floyd-Warshall all-pairs O(V^3), Kruskal's & Prim's MST, Tarjan's Strongly Connected Components and Bridges in O(V+E).

lessons.title: Segment Trees & Fenwick Trees (BIT)
lessons.desc: Point and range queries in O(log n); Lazy propagation for range updates; Coordinate compression; When to choose Fenwick over Segment Tree.

lessons.title: Bitmask Dynamic Programming & State Compression
lessons.desc: When n <= 20 signals bitmask DP; Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) in O(n^2 * 2^n); Matching and assignment problems; Iterating submasks in O(3^n).

lessons.title: Math, Probability & Reservoir Sampling
lessons.desc: Fast modular exponentiation; Fermat's Little Theorem for modular inverse; Sieve of Eratosthenes; Reservoir sampling on infinite streams; Expected value linearity.

lessons.title: String Algorithms: KMP, Rabin-Karp & Rolling Hash
lessons.desc: Knuth-Morris-Pratt (KMP) prefix failure function (LPS table); Rabin-Karp polynomial rolling hash; Palindrome detection with Manacher's; Z-algorithm.

lessons.title: Cyclic Sort & In-Place State Encodings
lessons.desc: The single most under-taught O(n) time O(1) space pattern: array value-as-index mapping. First Missing Positive, finding duplicates, and bit-sign state flags.

lessons.title: Topological Sort & DAG Dependency Resolution
lessons.desc: Kahns In-Degree BFS vs Tarjans Post-Order DFS. Cycle detection, topological ordering, Course Schedule II, and Alien Dictionary lexicographical order.

tracks.name: System Design (HLD & LLD)
tracks.description: Storage internals up through distributed systems, followed by production case studies run directly against the L5/Senior FAANG interview rubric.

lessons.title: Redis Internals & Eviction
lessons.desc: Internals, persistence (RDB/AOF), eviction algorithms (LRU/LFU), distributed locks with Redlock, cluster sharding.

lessons.title: Postgres I: Indexes & Scans
lessons.desc: B-tree internals, leftmost prefix rule, covering indexes, index-only scans, and BRIN indexes for append-only data.

lessons.title: Postgres II: MVCC & Locking
lessons.desc: MVCC, table bloat, autovacuum, transaction wraparound, isolation levels, row locks vs table locks, zero-downtime migrations.

lessons.title: Postgres III: Query Planner & Pooling
lessons.desc: Query planner, join algorithms (nested loop, hash join, merge join), work_mem sizing, partitioning, and PgBouncer connection pooling.

lessons.title: NoSQL, LSM Trees & Cassandra
lessons.desc: LSM trees, SSTables, Bloom filters, compaction strategies (size-tiered vs leveled), RUM conjecture, Cassandra partition keys, DynamoDB.

lessons.title: Latency Numbers & Capacity Estimation
lessons.desc: Latency ladder, six-step estimation framework, tail latency amplification, Little's Law, and the utilization cliff.

lessons.title: Replication & Sharding
lessons.desc: Sync/async/semi-sync replication, replication lag anomalies, split-brain, consistent hashing with virtual nodes, hot shards.

lessons.title: CAP Theorem to PACELC
lessons.desc: Consistency ladder: linearizability, sequential, causal, eventual; session guarantees; sloppy quorums; vector clocks; CRDTs.

lessons.title: Distributed Consensus & Raft
lessons.desc: Raft leader election & log replication, network partitions, etcd vs ZooKeeper, correct distributed locks with fencing tokens.

lessons.title: Idempotency, Outbox & Sagas
lessons.desc: Delivery semantics, idempotency keys, dual-write trap, transactional outbox pattern, Debezium CDC, 2PC vs choreo/orchestration sagas.

lessons.title: Kafka I: The Log & Producers
lessons.desc: Append-only commit log, zero-copy read (sendfile), partition assignment, batching, acks=all & the In-Sync Replica (ISR) trap.

lessons.title: Kafka II: Consumers & Compaction
lessons.desc: Consumer groups, incremental cooperative rebalancing, heartbeat vs poll loops, offset commit strategies, topic log compaction, dead letter queues (DLQs).

lessons.title: Docker & Container Internals
lessons.desc: Linux namespaces, cgroups, Copy-on-Write overlayfs, layer caching, PID 1 signal forwarding and zombie reaper.

lessons.title: Kubernetes I: Core Control Plane
lessons.desc: Reconciliation loop, etcd state, API server, Kubelet, Pod phase lifecycle, liveness/readiness/startup probes, QoS classes.

lessons.title: Kubernetes II: Networking & Rollouts
lessons.desc: ClusterIP/NodePort/Ingress, StatefulSets, rolling updates, graceful shutdown races, PodDisruptionBudgets (PDBs), Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA).

lessons.title: Networking, TLS & Load Balancing
lessons.desc: RTT math, TCP slow start, TLS 1.3 0-RTT, HTTP/2 multiplexing & HOL blocking, L4 vs L7 load balancing, gRPC load balancing dilemma, Anycast DNS, CDN.

lessons.title: API Design, Auth & Gateways
lessons.desc: REST semantics, Protobuf wire format, GraphQL N+1 problem, keyset pagination vs offset pagination, OAuth2/PKCE/OIDC/JWT validation, API Gateway architecture.

lessons.title: Resilience: Rate Limiting & Circuit Breakers
lessons.desc: Metastable failures, timeout budgets, exponential backoff with full jitter, circuit breakers, bulkhead isolation, 5 rate limiting algorithms, load shedding.

lessons.title: Observability: Metrics, Tracing & Alerting
lessons.desc: Metrics cardinality trap, HDR histograms, pull vs push (Prometheus vs StatsD), distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry (OTel), context propagation, multi-window burn-rate SLO alerts.

lessons.title: The System Design Interview Framework
lessons.desc: The 45-minute breakdown, the 4-axis grading rubric, requirements gathering, napkin math, high-level diagram, deep dive on bottlenecks.

lessons.title: Case Study: TinyURL & Distributed ID Generator
lessons.desc: Keyspace calculation, Base62 encoding, Snowflake ID vs UUID vs DB auto-increment, 301 Permanent vs 302 Temporary redirect analytics.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Rate Limiter
lessons.desc: Token bucket vs sliding window counter, Redis + Lua scripts for atomicity, local memory cache + async sync, fail-open vs fail-closed policies.

lessons.title: Case Study: WhatsApp / Real-Time Chat
lessons.desc: Persistent WebSockets, connection gateway servers, presence indicator (heartbeat vs push), message ordering and delivery receipts (sent, delivered, read).

lessons.title: Case Study: Twitter / Instagram Newsfeed
lessons.desc: Fanout-on-write vs Fanout-on-read, the celebrity/influencer problem (hybrid push-pull), timeline caching in Redis, pagination with cursor keysets.

lessons.title: Case Study: YouTube / Netflix Video Streaming
lessons.desc: Egress bandwidth cost, chunked transcoding, Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (HLS / DASH), CDN edge caching, video chunk deduplication.

lessons.title: Case Study: Uber / Geospatial Ride Matching
lessons.desc: Geohash vs Google S2 vs Uber H3 hexagonal indexing, ephemeral driver location updates (in-memory quadtree), atomic ride dispatch claims.

lessons.title: Case Study: Ad-Click Aggregator & Stream Processing
lessons.desc: Exactly-once count semantics with Flink/Kafka, tumbling vs sliding windows, event time vs processing time, watermarks and late-arriving clicks.

lessons.title: Case Study: Time-Series Metrics System
lessons.desc: Gorilla float compression (XOR delta-of-delta), timestamp delta-of-delta, inverted index for tag querying, high cardinality handling, data rollups.

lessons.title: Case Study: Payment Ledger & Digital Wallet
lessons.desc: Double-entry bookkeeping, preventing negative balance with optimistic locking, third-party payment gateway timeouts, reconciliation jobs.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Task Scheduler
lessons.desc: Top-of-the-hour spike mitigation, Postgres SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, distributed delay queues, leader election with leases.

lessons.title: Case Study: Google Search Typeahead / Autocomplete
lessons.desc: Prefix trie with top-k cached suggestions, offline MapReduce aggregation, client-side debouncing and caching, latency budget allocation.

lessons.title: Low-Level Design (LLD) & Machine Coding
lessons.desc: What is evaluated in 60-90 minutes, SOLID principles in code, 5 core design patterns (Strategy, Factory, Observer, State, Decorator), thread safety.

lessons.title: Case Study: Notification System
lessons.desc: Multi-channel fanout (Push, SMS, Email), user opt-out preference engine, rate limiting per user, notification deduplication, delivery tracking.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Cache (Memcached/Redis)
lessons.desc: Cache aside vs read/write-through vs write-behind, cache penetration/avalanche/stampede defenses (mutex lock, XFetch), hot key mitigation.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Object Storage (Amazon S3)
lessons.desc: Data node vs metadata service, Reed-Solomon erasure coding vs 3x replication, multipart uploads, strong read-after-write consistency.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Message Queue (SQS / RabbitMQ)
lessons.desc: Building the message broker from scratch: write-ahead log, partition indexing, visibility timeouts, at-least-once delivery, dead-lettering.

lessons.title: Case Study: Distributed Search Engine (Elasticsearch at Scale)
lessons.desc: Inverted index architecture, Term dictionary & Postings lists with Roaring Bitmaps, BM25 scoring, distributed segment creation, query coordinator.

lessons.title: Case Study: Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard & Docs (Google Docs / Figma)
lessons.desc: Operational Transformation (OT) vs Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs - Yjs/Automerge), WebSocket state syncing, undo/redo stacks, cursor broadcasting.

lessons.title: Case Study: Real-Time Gaming Leaderboard at 10M QPS
lessons.desc: Redis Sorted Sets (Skiplist + Hash), memory sharding by score percentiles, tie-breaking via timestamp bit-packing, write-behind caching to ScyllaDB/Postgres.

lessons.title: Distributed Transactions, Spanner TrueTime & Multi-Region DR
lessons.desc: Why 2PC blocks indefinitely on coordinator crash; Google Spanner TrueTime API and GPS/atomic clocks; Paxos groups; Active-Active multi-DC failover.

lessons.title: Machine Coding: Parking Lot, Splitwise & In-Memory DB
lessons.desc: Complete production-grade machine coding blueprint: class diagrams, design patterns (Strategy, Factory, Observer), thread-safety, CLI commands, unit tests.

lessons.title: Flash Sale & High-Concurrency Ticket Reservation (Ticketmaster)
lessons.desc: Inventory reservation under 100k QPS spikes: 10-minute hold TTLs, Redis distributed locking with fencing tokens, virtual waiting rooms, and transactional outbox idempotency.

lessons.title: Proximity Service & Location-Based Systems (Google Maps / Uber)
lessons.desc: Spatial indexing deep dive: Geohash vs QuadTree vs Google S2 vs Uber H3 hexagonal hierarchy. Dynamic driver clustering, radius queries, and map tile caching.

lessons.title: Ultra-Low Latency Stock Exchange & Order Matching Engine
lessons.desc: Sub-microsecond deterministic order matching: LMAX Disruptor ring buffers, Price-Time priority queues, kernel bypass (DPDK), zero-GC object pools, and replicated state machines.

tracks.name: AI Engineering & LLM Systems
tracks.description: Every measurement backed by runnable code. Production RAG, autonomous agent loops, context engineering, evals, safety guardrails, and AI interview case studies.

lessons.title: Environment & Architecture
lessons.desc: Conda isolation and shadowing trap; agent vs model boundary; OpenAI-compatible server abstraction.

lessons.title: RAG, From Scratch
lessons.desc: The whole pipeline in ~150 lines, no frameworks. Chunk -> embed -> index -> retrieve -> assemble -> generate -> cite.

lessons.title: Tokens & Embeddings
lessons.desc: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), non-English token inflation, what an embedding measures, bi-encoder vs cross-encoder.

lessons.title: Ingestion & Chunking Strategies
lessons.desc: Parsing as the true bottleneck: fixed, recursive, structural, and semantic chunking. The encoder cliff.

lessons.title: Hybrid Retrieval & Reranking
lessons.desc: The retrieval funnel: BM25 keyword search + dense vector retrieval fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), cross-encoder rerankers.

lessons.title: Evaluation of RAG Systems
lessons.desc: The RAG Triad (Context Relevance, Groundedness, Answer Relevance); LLM-as-a-judge calibration; Cohen's kappa agreement score.

lessons.title: Production RAG & Security
lessons.desc: Permission pre-filtering, the result-count oracle vulnerability, programmatic citation verification, long-context cost tradeoffs.

lessons.title: Context Engineering & Structured Output
lessons.desc: Five prompt variants ranked by empirical evals; structured JSON output contracts; token budgeting; memory condensation strategies.

lessons.title: The Automated Eval Harness
lessons.desc: Self-validating benchmark datasets, automated judges with CI regression gates, catching false regressions.

lessons.title: Model Behaviour & Prefix Caching
lessons.desc: Sampling mechanics (temperature, top_p, top_k) from scratch; determinism; prefix-caching economics and latency curves.

lessons.title: The Agent Loop from Scratch
lessons.desc: Full autonomous agent in ~200 lines: thought, action, observation, max steps, tool registry, error recovery, stop reason validation.

lessons.title: Orchestration & Durable Execution
lessons.desc: Checkpointing agent state, suspend/resume patterns around human-in-the-loop approvals, message compaction.

lessons.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
lessons.desc: A production JSON-RPC MCP server from scratch: tools vs resources vs prompts as trust boundaries; sandboxing.

lessons.title: Multi-Agent Architectures
lessons.desc: Hierarchical supervisor vs flat peer vs pipeline; context isolation as the true advantage; token cost escalation.

lessons.title: Prompt Injection & Defense In Depth
lessons.desc: Direct vs indirect prompt injection; why input regex/classifiers structurally fail; tool isolation and blast radius containment.

lessons.title: Red-Teaming & Adversarial Testing
lessons.desc: 30 structured attacks across 5 threat models: jailbreaks, data exfiltration, tool abuse, hallucination triggers.

lessons.title: Observability, Tracing & Cost Engineering
lessons.desc: Replayable traces, token burn rate alerting, dynamic model routing (cheap SLM vs frontier LLM), output token throttling.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning vs RAG vs In-Context Learning
lessons.desc: The decision ladder: when to fine-tune; LoRA and QLoRA mechanics; CPU embedding fine-tuning; model distillation.

lessons.title: Senior AI Architectural Judgment
lessons.desc: When NOT to use an LLM; the 17-row decision matrix; trade-offs between deterministic code and generative models.

lessons.title: The AI Engineering Interview Framework
lessons.desc: The 7-phase timeline; why eval strategy must come at minute 5 BEFORE architecture; deep dive protocol for projects.

lessons.title: Case Study: Enterprise RAG at Scale
lessons.desc: 50M documents, 100k users, strict ACL permissions, sub-second latency, zero data leak across departments.

lessons.title: Case Study: Autonomous Agent Platform
lessons.desc: Tool gateway, durable execution, approval gates, blast radius containment, rate limit handling, idempotency.

lessons.title: Case Study: Universal LLM Gateway
lessons.desc: Provider abstraction, intelligent semantic routing, token quotas, multi-tenant billing, streaming failover trap.

lessons.title: High-Throughput LLM Serving: vLLM & PagedAttention
lessons.desc: Continuous dynamic batching vs static batching; PagedAttention memory fragmentation fix; KV cache offloading; Speculative decoding; TTFT vs ITL metrics.

lessons.title: Semantic Vector Caching & Prompt Routing
lessons.desc: Exact match vs cosine similarity threshold caching (GPTCache/Redis); Embedding distance drift; Tiered model routing (8B SLM vs 70B/400B Frontier).

lessons.title: Constrained Generation & Logits Guardrails (Outlines)
lessons.desc: Logit masking with Context-Free Grammars (CFG); 100% deterministic JSON extraction without retry loops; Guardrails AI and NeMo integration.

lessons.title: Model Alignment: RLHF, DPO & Synthetic Data Distillation
lessons.desc: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data curation; Reward modeling; Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) mathematics; Synthetic instruction distillation with LLM filtering.

blocks.t: Production ML System Design (Meta / Netflix / Google)

lessons.title: Two-Tower Recommendation System Architecture (Meta / Netflix)
lessons.desc: Industry standard recommender funnel: Candidate retrieval with user/item embedding towers + ScaNN/HNSW ANN vector index -> DLRM / DeepFM Heavy Ranker -> Contextual Bandits diversity.

tracks.name: Behavioral, Leadership & Compensation
tracks.description: The gate that decides whether you pass and what your passing is worth in INR. STAR-L stories, hard questions, Googleyness, Amazon LPs, and negotiating your offer.

lessons.title: What the Behavioral Round Actually Grades
lessons.desc: The six scored signals; STAR-L and the 'L' (Learning) letter everyone forgets; the 2-minute rule; story altitude; handling aggressive follow-ups.

lessons.title: Your Core Engineering Stories Inventory
lessons.desc: Drafting 8 core stories from your actual engineering record: architecture rewrite, high-stakes migration, team leadership, production outage, conflict resolution.

lessons.title: The High-Stakes Killer Questions
lessons.desc: Why you are leaving without sounding resentful; the Manager-to-IC pivot; explain a genuine failure where you were at fault; handling gaps.

lessons.title: Company-Specific Loops (Amazon LP & Googleyness)
lessons.desc: Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles mapped to stories; Google's Googleyness & navigating ambiguity; Meta's focus on velocity and impact.

lessons.title: The Recruiter Screen & Compensation Defense
lessons.desc: The 4 sentences that protect your number; why current salary should never enter the chat; reading an Indian CTC breakdown; ESOP vs RSU; competing offer leverage.

lessons.title: Mock Behavioral Rounds & Self-Scoring
lessons.desc: Six timed mock scenarios, 7-axis rubric, time-to-first-'I' metric that turns group summaries into personal ownership.

lessons.title: Leveling Matrix: Senior (L5) vs Mid (L4) Mastery
lessons.desc: What separates an L4 offer from an L5 offer: driving technical RFCs, cross-team consensus without authority, proactive risk identification, blameless postmortems.

lessons.title: India Tech CTC Breakdown & Equity Playbook
lessons.desc: Anatomy of high-paying Indian tech offers: Base vs Performance Bonus vs Joining Bonus vs Stocks; 4-year vesting backload trap; Perquisite tax on ESOP exercise; Counter-offer scripts.
